name: CrewPoppy (Google Cloud)
description: Your AI crew, in your own Google Cloud. Starts with one member — the Briefer, who reads the memory you keep in MemoryPoppy and writes your morning brief. Every read is written on your Activity.

compliance.dataHandled: The briefs it writes and, later, your agents' definitions, memory and spend records — kept in a database inside a Google Cloud project of your own. It reads people and meetings from the memory poppy you installed, through AgentsPoppy, with a receipt for every read. Nothing is copied anywhere else, and in this release nothing is sent to a model.

permissionSet.name: CrewPoppy (Google Cloud)
permissionSet.description: Keeps its own records — the briefs it writes for you, and later your agents — in a database inside its own Google Cloud project, which needs no card. Reads people and meetings from your memory poppy, through AgentsPoppy, for the purpose named on every receipt.

grants.reason: Keeps the briefs it writes for you — and later your agents' definitions, memory and spend records — in a database inside its own project, so nothing of your crew's lives outside your cloud.

memory.reason: Briefs you on the meetings ahead and the people in them, from the memory you keep — the Briefer reads, it never writes.
